audit.whatIsWrong: All seven full-layer phases[N].side rows disagreed with content win[N]. Full read Syndra/Syndra/Skill/Skill/Syndra/Skill/Syndra; content read Skill/Skill/Syndra/Syndra/Malzahar/Syndra/Skill, which is exactly the packet levelChart.
audit.why: Content layer matches the packet and its whys[] are already grounded (her range wins 3-5, your R wins 6, her first item wins that row). The full layer was the wrong one.
audit.corrected: phases side moved to Skill/Skill/Syndra/Syndra/Malzahar/Syndra/Skill, each why rewritten in the same proposal to state the new verdict. win[N] not edited — it already holds the target values.

audit.whatIsWrong: phases[5].why claimed the first-item row for Malzahar's Liandry's while the content layer and packet both give that row to Syndra.
audit.why: Syndra's Luden's/Rod spike plus Unleashed Power's execute (Transcendent upgrades R to execute low-health targets) is the larger first-item swing; Unleashed Power is 120s at rank 1.
audit.corrected: phases[5].why now names her burst spike; her spike cadence also recorded in cooldowns.

audit.whatIsWrong: The full layer never gave a Syndra cooldown, invented "Iron Boundary" for Malzahar's passive (real name Void Shift), and its trade lines described poking a shield Syndra does not have.
audit.why: Kit authority: Scatter the Weak is 15s at every rank, 650 range, stuns only when it passes through a Dark Sphere; Dark Sphere is 7s at 800 range; Force of Will is 12/11/10/9/8s at 925 and carries true damage via Transcendent; Unleashed Power is 120/100/80 at 675 and executes. Syndra has no dash in her kit, which is why Nether Grasp is lethal on her.
audit.corrected: Cooldowns, trade lines, don'ts and carry all rewritten around those numbers.

audit.why: Scatter the Weak's flat 15s is the single most punishable window in the matchup and was never stated.
audit.corrected: Rewritten with 15s E, 7s Q, 12s W early, 120s R.

audit.whatIsWrong: missingInteractions flags resistances-invalidated: Transcendent gives Force of Will bonus true damage, so stacking MR is the wrong answer, and the itemization entry did not say so.
audit.why: True damage ignores MR by definition; the kit flag and Riot's passive text agree.
audit.corrected: report[8].t now points at Banshee's over raw MR and says why.

audit.why: champ-gender lists syndra as female; every lint MISGENDER entry in this brief is one of these.
audit.corrected: All flagged fields rewritten with she/her.

edits.before: E a caster minion and let the visions farm for you — your lane is a macro pattern, not a duel, from the first wave.
edits.after: E a caster minion and farm — Dark Sphere is 7s and neither of you can force anything yet. Even, and quiet by design.

edits.before: Q online: the silence is your trade answer. Use it on his engage spell, not on poke he can walk around.
edits.after: Q online, but her 800-range Dark Sphere out-ranges your step-up. Even — silence only what she commits with.

edits.before: W voidlings turn your shove permanent — the wave hits his tower while you ward, roam-shadow, or just exist safely.
edits.after: Voidlings shove for you, but Scatter the Weak through a sphere stuns from 650 and her Q-W poke out-ranges all of it.

edits.before: Lost Chapter and the machine is complete: E-hops fund themselves, the wave is always crashing, and his tower is always bleeding.
edits.after: Lost Chapter funds your E-hops, but she zones you off the wave with spheres and chips you toward her level-6 execute.

edits.before: Liandry's spike: visions melt waves AND health bars. Suppress-into-burn kills through most defensive answers.
edits.after: First item is her spike, not yours — sphere burst into Unleashed Power one-shots squishies. Farm safe, hold Void Shift.

edits.before: Late Malz is a number: one suppression on their carry equals one won teamfight. Shield up, flank smart, press R.
edits.after: Even late: she has no escape from your R, but a sphere stun into her ult deletes you first if you get caught out.

edits.before: - Syndra Scatter the Weak (Stun): matchup-defining — The QE stun cone starts every kill combo — stay off the line between her and her orbs. Read it like a second minimap. - Guard your spell shield (Iron Boundary) like a fifth summoner spell. - Ultimate goes to kill windows only.
edits.after: - Scatter the Weak is 15s at every rank — the longest window in her kit and the one your step-ups are timed to. - Dark Sphere is 7s so the poke never stops; Force of Will is 12s early. - Unleashed Power is 120s at rank 1, and Void Shift covers you until it comes back.

edits.before: His poke pops your shield, your shove pops his tempo — the lane is a war between his range and your metronome.
edits.after: Her poke pops your shield, your shove pops her tempo — the lane is a war between her 800 range and your metronome.

edits.before: Out-shove his tempo, shield-manage his poke, and convert 6 into point-and-click kills. Every commit starts with one question: is Scatter the Weak (Stun) down?
edits.after: Out-shove her tempo, shield-manage her poke, and convert 6 into point-and-click kills. Every commit starts with one question: is Scatter the Weak (Stun) down? It is 15s.

edits.before: Syndra wins by landing Scatter the Weak (Stun), denying your pattern, and out-ranging your plan one polite trade at a time.
edits.after: Syndra wins by stunning you off a sphere, chipping with Force of Will's true damage, and executing you under her ult threshold.

edits.before: Pop-and-punish: poke his shield off with a cheap E-tick, then Q-W-E the gap before it rebuilds — full rotations only ever land on shieldless targets.
edits.after: Poke with E from max range and let it tick — Scatter the Weak is 15s at every rank, so the moment she spends it on the wave you own the next fifteen seconds.

edits.before: Trading into him with YOUR shield down — you are the squishiest scaling mage in the pool the moment the purple bubble disappears.
edits.after: Trading with Void Shift down — Dark Sphere at 800 range and Force of Will's true damage mean resistances do not save you from her chip.
